description: The grouped bar chart illustrates the "effect" across four different "tag" categories for six distinct models. The horizontal category axis, labeled "tag", displays four categories in the following order: "case", "gender", "number", and "tense". The vertical value axis, labeled "effect", uses a linear scale with a visible numeric range from 0 to 20, featuring tick marks and corresponding horizontal grid lines at intervals of 5 units. Within each of the four tag categories, the data is represented by a group of six adjacent bars. According to the legend, these bars correspond to different models, distinguished by color: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (light red), and XLM-B₂ (dark red). Every bar is outlined in black and includes a prominent black I-beam error bar extending above and below the top edge of the bar, with several error bars extending below the zero line. The "case" category contains the tallest bars overall, with the mBERT-B₂ bar reaching approximately 12.2 and the XLM-B₂ bar reaching roughly 11.2; these also feature the largest error bars, extending up to approximately 21 and 20, respectively. The "gender" and "number" categories show moderate effect values, with their tallest bars (mBERT-B₂) measuring approximately 4.2 and 2.8, respectively. The "tense" category contains the shortest bars, with values for XLM-L₂, mBERT-R₂, and XLM-R₂ appearing near zero, and the highest value in this group belonging to XLM-B₂ at approximately 0.6. The categories on the horizontal axis are not sorted alphabetically or by overall value, while the bars within each group consistently follow the order defined by the legend.
